name: r13-d-e1-balanced-ranges-h49
author: solx-loop
description: H53, supported on 16,384 only. Static token ranges for the GEMM1 tiles let a tile straddle images, so every CTA gets one balanced tile. Each tile adds its per-(image,k) sumsq into gsq, publishes on every image it touches, and rebuilds inv_b from gsq with a CTA reduction. At 16,384 this removes the 2-tile tail: 46.4 vs 50.5 us for r12-merge's tc2 (-8.3 %), and 46.1 vs 50.9 against r12's tc_kernel in one container.
